lines.text: Press NEXT. Which sentence needs the gold? Press GOLD and read it again.
Unequal gaps between three parallel lines do not break their parallelism.
The sum is 180 degrees. Did the labels measure these corners?
Choose PLANE, DISK or SPHERE. Predict the angle sum before moving HOST.
This slider bends its own sketch. It does not control the other exhibits.
A dome-like picture invites a question about measurement; its silhouette is not the metric.
The drawing has a rim. In the hyperbolic metric, that boundary is infinitely far away.
A saddle changes how straightness looks. What path would stay straight within it?
The complex plane gains one point at infinity. Walking around this model is another journey.
A changed axiom, a different geometry. Which permission is being reconsidered here?
Everyone moves from n to n + 1. This surprise has an answer.
Choose IN. Now try OUT. What changes when the rule begins within an existing set?
Does a brace inside a brace depict another set, or the very same set?
The barber belongs to the group. Who shaves the barber?
An inside with another inside. Does drawing another box answer the membership question?
The lamp stages a difficulty about truth. A timer supplies its rhythm.
Does a machine failing to find a proof show that no proof exists?
Assume a sound arithmetic theory. The gap illustrates a relation; its size does not count truths.
Add an axiom to close the gap and a new gap opens above - incompleteness all the way up
Follow the marker. Where does the rise return?
You recognised a pipe before asking what you could do with it.
Do the ends meet, or only their images? Move sideways.
Two rods below, three tines above. Follow one edge through the change.
existence without construction is an article of faith, not a proof
lines.note: existence here cannot be asserted, only produced: the proof depends on somebody building the witness in time, and pays in everything true but unbuilt — the platforms that trail off are not false, they are unconstructed.

note_src.quote: The unreachable platforms are not false. They are unconstructed.

lines.text: an infinite object that is never finished is not incomplete
Brouwer's intuitionism: the next step isn't true-or-false until you construct it
the law of excluded middle is not a law of logic

pearls.edge: no test inside the chamber tells the two ghosts apart, so undecidability only becomes legible on a screen bolted to the wall: the lesson needs the outside view the fight forbids, or it reads as bad aim.

edge_src.quote: Without the screen, the learner would experience the encounter as a frustrating combat with an elusive enemy and might blame themselves

lines.text: observation does not reveal a pre-existing state — it creates one
lines.note: the box cannot show what it holds — superposition needs the lid shut — so its only freedom is where to put the part it cannot display: sealed in the core, split to a twin, smeared into haze.

note_src.quote: the one thing a box can actually argue about: WHAT IT DOES WITH THE FACT THAT YOU ARE OUTSIDE IT

lines.text: Florensky's paraconsistency: open AND closed, P and not-P, and the world does not end
A and not-A can both be true. This is not a failure of logic but a description of reality that classical logic cannot contain
superposition is not uncertainty about which state the system is in
lambda is the entropy drive — the dial between crystallization and dissolution that every living system must …
lines.note: the dial depends on a calibration chain that ends nowhere — there is no metre bar for how much a system should value disorder — so the instrument covers the gap by painting the right answer on in green.

note_src.quote: An instrument's authority comes from its calibration chain; this one's chain ends nowhere

lines.text: phi is the queer parameter — positive phi means the system does not merely tolerate change but seeks it as …
the edge of chaos is not a metaphor — it is a precise mathematical boundary where computation is …
the formula is not an equation to solve but a lens to see every system through
